summary: Yudkowsky calls for an international law to halt AI development short of superintelligence, which he argues current methods cannot make safe.

statements.quote: Specifically: There ought to be a law against further escalation of AGI capabilities, trying to halt it short of the point where it births superintelligence.
statements.venue: Essay, Only Law Can Prevent Extinction

statements.quote: There’s in fact a difference between calling for a law, and calling for individual outbursts of violence.
statements.venue: Essay, Only Law Can Prevent Extinction

statements.quote: AI is already a state-level potential danger, if not quite yet a state-level actual power.
statements.venue: Essay, Only Law Can Prevent Extinction

statements.quote: There’s literally nothing else our species can bet on in terms of how we eventually end up colonizing the galaxies
